subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Keep a straight face

options.text: Look serious though you want to laugh

solution:
The correct answer is **"Look serious though you want to laugh."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"keep a straight face" **means to maintain a serious or neutral expression, even in a humorous or absurd situation. (किसी हास्यप्रद या बेतुकी स्थिति में भी गंभीर या तटस्थ अभिव्यक्ति बनाए रखना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She tried to **keep a straight face**__ but, unable to contain herself, burst into laughter.*
 
 
 
• This can be important in situations where it would be inappropriate or unprofessional to show amusement or disbelief.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
